prompt:

Asset type: MMO Idle material inventory icon, final 32x32 PNG, displayed at 24px.

Composition: one isolated fragment centered on square canvas, occupies 78 percent of the frame, slight diagonal, generous padding; bold literal object silhouette readable at 24px.

Palette: lane colour #c58fff is the dominant material tint with charcoal shadows and a narrow pale edge.

Constraints: material fragment only; no relic, iron plaque, square plate, polished gemstone, complete equipment piece, or drop shadow. No words, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, badge, border, frame, pedestal, scene, character, face, jewellery setting, tiny filigree, particle cloud, realistic rendering, or additional unrelated objects. Generate this ONE icon alone.
preprocessing: Direct nearest-neighbor resize to 32px; generated alpha preserved.
review: No acceptance or rejection by the agent.
